news.headline: Rescued Baby Walrus Finds a Forever Home
news.body: A college student studying a beach in Alaska spotted a lone baby walrus and helped rescue him. He was named Annautaq. Experts said he is too used to people to live in the wild, so he now lives at SeaWorld Orlando. He weighs about 250 pounds and gets up to six bottle feedings a day.

news.headline: Twin NASA Probes Slingshot Toward Mars
news.body: Two NASA spacecraft called ESCAPADE zoomed close to Earth and fired their engines to get a boost toward Mars. It is the first time NASA has used this trick to send a spacecraft to the Red Planet. Both burns went perfectly, and the probes will study Mars's magnetic field.

news.headline: How Octopuses Squeeze Through Tiny Holes
news.body: Scientists watched octopuses escape through small openings. First an octopus feels the hole with one arm, then it threads more arms through, and finally it pulls its body through. The findings could help engineers build soft rescue robots that fit into tight spaces.

fun_fact: An octopus has nine brains: one in its head and one in each arm! 🐙
